name: HOL Plugins
summary: HOL's searchable registry of agent plugins for Codex, Claude Code, Cursor, OpenCode, Copilot CLI and other runtimes, each with a 0-100 static-scan Trust Score.
description: Plugins are listed from GitHub for free (hol.org/registry/plugins/submit) and grouped by runtime (Codex, Claude Code, Cursor, Antigravity, OpenCode, Hermes, OpenClaw, GitHub Copilot CLI, Kimi, Grok, Pi and others). The Trust Score is a weighted sum of six static-scan components, capped when high-severity findings appear; HOL says paid memberships and payments are not inputs. Optional paid owner checkmarks: HOL Blue $4.99/month, Gold $29/month. Scores come from the same scanner as HOL Guard (PyPI `plugin-scanner`/`hol-guard`), with a companion dataset (HashgraphOnline/hol-plugin-security on Hugging Face) and the Apache-2.0 list hashgraph-online/awesome-ai-plugins. Commercial reuse or bulk extraction of the scores needs HOL's permission. Operated by HOL DAO LLC; submitted by HOL via issue #27.
